name: Multi-asset contract COLA override per asset (keying bug)
what_it_tests: Contract override COLA percents must apply per asset on a multi-asset contract; AssetContractQueryHelper keying by ContractId only collapses 3 of 4 assets to the CMDT default with a mislabeled source
proc_mechanism: AssetContractQueryHelper.cls query groups by ContractId only, losing per-asset distinctness; prehook per-ACR keying unaffected; Contract_COLA_Override_Percent__c joined per asset
expected_behavior: Each asset uses its own Contract_COLA_Override_Percent__c, not collapsed to the first match -> 4 distinct UnitPrices
test_setup: Contract with 4 related assets, each with a distinct override rate, COLA renewal quote for all 4

prior_run.actual: queryAssetContracts returned only 1 row (last asset RVDQ): RVDQ=4% Contract Override (UnitPrice 2102.10 correct); RVDN/RVDO/RVDP collapsed to CMDT default 7.85% (UnitPrice 6539.75 vs correct 6306.30, +233.45 each), COLA_Source mislabeled 'CMDT Lookup'.
prior_run.evidence: Contract 00003473 https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Contract/800WC00000PCpoMYAT/view ; Asset RVDN https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Asset/02iWC000007RVDNYA4/view ; live Apex probe F05_PROBE rowsReturned=1, MISSING={RVDN,RVDO,RVDP}
prior_run.defectStep: AssetContractQueryHelper.buildResults (COLA prehook feeding V21 'COLA Uplift on Renewal' steps 26-28)
prior_run.notes: Bug reproduced deterministically on live data: 1 Activated multi-asset contract (800WC00000PCpoMYAT/00003473, COLA_Override_Percent__c=4, 4 ACRs, Solution Category 'Doc Management' CMDT default 7.85%). Defect is in the Apex prehook layer upstream of V21; V21 COLA gate fires on already-wrong COLA_Uplift_Percent. Field is COLA_Override_Percent__c (catalog loosely names it Contract_COLA_Override_Percent__c).
